_comment: schema: { id (kebab-case unique), name (dish display name), ingredients ([[fish_name, qty], ...]), stamina (i32 stamina restored on cook), effect (optional buff string; see buffs.rs), description (one-liner; sentence-case, semicolon-joined buff). Cooking removes the ingredients from the basket and applies stamina + the effect once. Order matters for save migration: only append, never reorder.

name: Carp Stew
description: Pond carp slow-simmered with roots, fat pools on the surface; +40 stam, +0.5% sell.

name: Bluegill Fry
description: Three bluegills pan-fried in butter, basted with thyme, rosemary, garlic hopefully; +35 stam.

name: Rainbow Trout Soup
description: Rainbow trout in clear river broth; the fish brings enough color +60 stam, +1% sell.

name: Salmon Roe Bowl
description: Twin-salmon roe over hot rice; crunchy in a boba way. +90 stam, +1.5% sell.

name: Catfish Stew
description: Slowly simmered with flakes of fried skin. Hopefully there's some peppers and potatoes; +70 stam.

name: Northern Pike Grill
description: Charred black lines, the skin comes off cleanly. Red with seasoning; +80 stam, -2% bite wait.

name: Yellow Perch Platter
description: Nicely sat on lettuce, the whole fish is tender and charred; +55 stam.

name: Sturgeon Roast
description: It's evenly roasted, golden brown; +140 stam, +3% sell.

name: Yellowfin Tuna Steak
description: It's slightly medium-rare. The nice magenta contrasts with the taupe and cream colors; +120 stam, +2% sell.

name: Mahi-Mahi Tacos
description: Diced mahi fills the tortilla. Hopefully there's some diced onion and tomatoes. There's some absurdly spicy chili flakes there; +95 stam, +1% walk speed.

name: Whole Snapper Bake
description: So soft, you can't even tell it's solid. Essentially a liquid but somehow pleasant; +85 stam, +1.2% sell.

name: Anchovy Toast
description: Close to potato chips in texture. The tails get stuck between your teeth; +30 stam.

name: American Eel Pie
description: Gross. Slightly sweet, the meat is terribly hard; +75 stam, +1.5% sell.

name: Cod and Chips
description: Proper british eats. You'd fancy a bo'o o' wo'o next to this; +65 stam.

name: Halibut Roast
description: You don't know that you're supposed to remove the fins. They are very rubbery. The fish is coated in a nice golden brown crust; +130 stam, +2.5% sell.

name: Tuna Carpaccio
description: It's raw, but it's supposed to be that way. This feels like just an appetizer; +110 stam, +2% sell.

name: Smoked Salmon Plate
description: You only like this with cream cheese and toast. Good thing you have neither. Tastes like human skin, and the sea; +100 stam, -3% bite wait.

name: Arctic Char Grill
description: You grilled this arctic fish. What an oxymoron. Eat this coincidentia oppositorum, please; +85 stam, +1.2% sell.

name: Ghost Broth
description: It's a stew of ectoplasm, essentially. Gooey. It will be a spiritual experience. You cooked off all meat and bone. Didn't know that was possible; +100 stam, +2% luck.

name: Fog-Sea Stew
description: You cooked off literally everything. There is just some steam left in the bowl. You can... inhale it... I guess? +180 stam, +5% luck.
